Name: ATTACHEFFECT_FILTER_PARAM_ST
Description: Options of the relic effect filter. Each row is one option listed under its sub-category, hidden while its event flag is off and sorted by its filter value; AttachEffectParam's filter ID points here.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on 19 of 426 rows.

Fields.Name: Filter Entry Text ID
Fields.Description: Text shown for this entry in the relic effect filter list (retail: usually the row ID, an attach effect text).

Fields.Name: Sub-Category
Fields.Description: AttachEffectFilterSubCategoryParam row (tab) this entry is listed under.

Fields.Name: Sort Order
Fields.Description: Order of the entry inside its sub-category list (lower first). Retail: a different value on every row.

Fields.Name: Display Event Flag
Fields.Description: The entry is listed only while this event flag is on. 0 or -1: always listed. Retail: 131 on 75 rows, 6043 / 6044 / 6951 on DLC-related entries.
